lead_raw_text:
The structure of K2EuAs3 crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with a unit cell containing 24 atoms—K8 Eu4 As12—distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral coordination for both As and Eu, with each As center surrounded by six neighbors (four K, two Eu) and each Eu center by six As neighbors, while K centers show a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 geometric neighbors. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 24 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and edge-sharing between As octahedra, and edge-sharing between As and K polyhedra.
